input_contract: Calibration targets are exact decimal strings or analytic quantiles; R tests round inputs and references to nearest double. Recorded deltas quantify decimal-versus-double targets.
generator: generate.py retained outside source in the owning validation evidence directory
huge_cdf_method: Standardized log-density quadrature truncated at -14 SD; tangent bound below 1e-43 for supplied huge shapes.
analytic_shape_quantiles: Exact formulas for alpha=1, beta=1 and arcsine; other quantiles use 180 bisections at65-digit precision. Printed45-digit quantiles have error well below double precision.

fixture_methods.bayesian-three-region-pmf.csv: 65-digit log-gamma beta-binomial PMF; independently computed for eachcount; no adjacent-count recurrence
fixture_methods.bayesian-three-region-bf.csv: 65-digit prior/posterior region integrals; standardized quadrature for hugecentralshapes, regularized incompletebeta otherwise

formatting_note: CSV line endings normalized to LF; generator explicitly emits LF. Numeric contents unchanged.
